Install HYB26-skill

IN THIS REPOSITORY

Nothing to install. Copilot discovers .github/skills/hyb26-skill when you work
in a badger/home checkout. Tools run from .github/skills/hyb26-skill/scripts.

PERSONAL INSTALL (any project)

1. Install Python 3.10 or newer and check it:
       python3 --version          (Windows: python --version)

2. From this skill folder run:
       sh ./install-skill.sh      (macOS / Linux)
       .\install-skill.ps1        (Windows PowerShell)

3. The skill is copied to ~/.copilot/skills/hyb26-skill. Check with:
       copilot skill list
   In an open CLI session use /skills reload, or restart it. Rerun the
   installer to update; unrelated files are kept.

4. Install mpremote to talk to a badge:
       python3 -m pip install mpremote     (Windows: python -m pip install mpremote)
   Use a virtual environment if the system Python refuses packages.

5. Open your badge project folder (a plain folder is fine) before asking
   Copilot to build an app. Do not use the skill folder as the project.

CHECK THE RESULT

Ask Copilot:
       Use hyb26-skill to explain how to put my badge into USB Disk Mode and
       show my app's icon in the menu. Do not change any files.

The answer should mention badge_serial.py disk-mode (or
powman.reset_into_msc()), the Mass Storage app, double-tapping RESET, and
patch_menu_icons.py for menus that ignore icon.png.

For VS Code or another Copilot client, check its supported skill locations in
its documentation and reload it before running the same prompt.
